conclusions.text: Website Traffic is now live on the board (GA4 connected): ~498K active users year-to-date with a steady monthly trend. Saudi Arabia is our dominant market (~195K users), far ahead of UAE (~11K) and Kuwait (~6.5K).

Most website traffic is direct + Google organic search; paid social (Instagram/Facebook) is a smaller share — we rely heavily on brand/direct and SEO, with room to grow paid-social-driven site traffic.

Owned-social net follower growth is 85,385 Jan–Jul = ~30% of the annual target — behind pace, worth a focused growth push. App Store ratings are stable (~4.3 English, ~4.6 Arabic) and now shown as a 12-month trend.
Brand search interest for 51Talk is strongest in Saudi Arabia; Kuwait and UAE are sparse — consistent with the website market split.
